goal: Discharge the open premise STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS (Codex P1 on #176): show that the unique maximum in being also has the conditions the premise drops from the nominal definition, namely remotum ab omnibus (q.13 a.8 ad 2; way of negation, cf. q.3) and cause of goodness and every perfection (quarta via; unity of the maxima, cf. q.4 a.2, q.6 a.2), so that the full description of q.13 a.8 ad 2 / et hoc dicimus Deum applies to it.
reason: Open premise of AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-MAXIME-ENS-IS-GOD and the stage-1 route via maxime ens; withoutNominalDefinitionNotGod verifies that it is needed.
